text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no shell tool, so the suite hasn't been run. I fixed each bug by reading the code against the tests, so please run it to confirm.

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment and tests say five. It is now 5.
- **`fees.py`**: the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing Emma. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copies are my guess.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events. It now returns the last `n`, and `[]` when `n <= 0`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left `year` as a string. It now converts it to an int.
